descFull: AI-first 3D & AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose + Filament), Apple (SwiftUI + RealityKit) and the web. Opens glTF/GLB, 3MF, STL, OBJ and PLY on Android and USDZ on Apple, at real size in AR. An assistant reads llms.txt and writes code that compiles first try; also an MCP server and a ChatGPT/Codex plugin.
